mapper.sql: select l.call_id, l.agent_code, l.prompt_version, l.prompt_hash, l.model_used, l.fallback_used, l.attempts, l.status, l.error_msg, l.prompt_tokens, l.completion_tokens, l.cost, l.latency_ms, l.biz_type, l.biz_id, l.review_id, l.create_by, l.create_time from abr_ai_call_log l
mapper.select: select l.call_id, l.agent_code, l.prompt_version, l.prompt_hash, l.model_used, l.fallback_used, l.attempts, l.status, l.error_msg, l.input_summary, l.output, l.prompt_tokens, l.completion_tokens, l.cost, l.latency_ms, l.biz_type, l.biz_id, l.review_id, l.create_by, l.create_time from abr_ai_call_log l where l.call_id = #{callId}
mapper.insert: insert into abr_ai_call_log (call_id, agent_code, prompt_version, prompt_hash, model_used, fallback_used, attempts, status, error_msg, input_summary, output, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cost, latency_ms, biz_type, biz_id, review_id, create_by, create_time) values (#{callId}, #{agentCode}, coalesce(#{promptVersion}, ''), coalesce(#{promptHash}, ''), coalesce(#{modelUsed}, ''), coalesce(#{fallbackUsed}, 'N'), coalesce(#{attempts}, 0), #{status}, coalesce(#{errorMsg}, ''), coalesce(#{inputSummary}, ''), #{output}, coalesce(#{promptTokens}, 0), coalesce(#{completionTokens}, 0), coalesce(#{cost}, 0), coalesce(#{latencyMs}, 0), coalesce(#{bizType}, ''), coalesce(#{bizId}, ''), #{reviewId}, coalesce(#{createBy}, ''), now())
mapper.select: select to_char((l.create_time at time zone current_setting('TimeZone')) at time zone 'Asia/Shanghai', 'YYYY-MM-DD') as day, l.agent_code, count(*) as calls, count(*) filter (where l.status = 'success') as success_calls, count(*) filter (where l.status = 'error') as error_calls, coalesce(sum(l.prompt_tokens), 0) as prompt_tokens, coalesce(sum(l.completion_tokens), 0) as completion_tokens, coalesce(sum(l.cost), 0) as cost from abr_ai_call_log l where l.create_time >= #{beginTime} and l.create_time < #{endTime} group by 1, 2 order by 1, 2
